title: 第2385章 有生机石第2384章 还得靠她
slug: 皇叔借点功德王妃把符画猛了
lines: 司徒佳萱觉得自己一口血就要喷出来了。
在这一刻，她是真的对这些兄弟失去了力气，甚至怀疑起一切来。
她不知道自己从小到大被族人称赞的优秀到底算什么。
也不知道一直说是簇拥在她身边的这些人到底算什么。
那块生机石，是她有一次得到的机缘，那一次她其实也算是九死一生，受了很重的伤，养了三个月才好起来。
一开始他们都不知道那到底是什么东西，还是后来父亲遇到了高人，受了指点，才知道那是生机石，那是那个时候，他们也才知道生机石有什么作用。
只要有玄术，生机石就等于是上等人参的作用，能够吊命。
受重伤的时候，说是一片年份好的上等人参含在嘴里就能吊命，生机石也是一样的，能够将里面的生机抽出来输入身体里，就能够吊命。
要是有足够的生机，几乎就等于多一条命了。但那位高人说，一般不可能拥有那么多的生机石的，能得一块已经是莫大的机缘。
因为只有那么一块，父亲倒也没有让她把那块生机石交上去，而是让她自己收着。
但是也叮嘱过族里知道的那些人，莫要把这件事情随意透露出去，免得引来不必要的觊觎。
生机石在一般人眼里可能根本不知道怎么使用，但若遇到玄门中人，他们知道怎么用，也知道它的珍贵，肯定会起贪欲的。
司徒佳萱没有想到，这个自己视若亲弟的少年，会直接就把这事说出来了。
要知道，这里的人就有玄门中人啊！
这么说出来，就不怕给她找麻烦？
还是说，因为这些人救了他们，就确定这些人一定是好人？
司徒佳萱面无表情。
殷长行和殷云庭有些意外。没有想到她手里竟然有生机石。
司徒庚虽然觉得这事直接说出来不好，但现在事出有因，这不是自家兄弟要用到吗？
于是他也看向司徒佳萱，“佳萱，要不然就先把那块生机石拿出来给小顺，你也不想看到他出事的吧？正好，这几位大师会玄术，应该知道怎么使用生机石。”
其实司徒佳萱拿着生机石也没有用，他们不会用。
所以司徒庚觉得趁着这里有人会用，拿出来救治小顺是最合适不过了。
司徒佳萱说道，“我没有把生机石带在身边，它在家里。”
她一直被族人视为天才，也视为家族荣光，荣耀越大，责任越大，所以她其实经常出来为族里办事，父母也常给她任务，让她完成任务才能回去。
那些任务，很多时候真的称不上容易，她也是经常会遇到危险的！
就算她不会使用那块生机石，但事实上她一直在寻找能够教她使用的人了！
等她找到，学会了使用它，以后那就是她一块保命的底牌。
现在他们轻飘飘两句话就要让她把生机石让出来。
司徒佳萱看向殷长行，问道，“请问大师，他这种情况，能够慢慢再想办法吗？”
content_en:
Situ Jiaxuan felt like her blood would spurt out.
At this moment, she really lost all strength towards these brothers and even doubted everything.
She didn't know what the excellence she had been praised by her tribe for growing up was.
She also didn’t know who these people who had always been said to be surrounding her were.
That piece of vitality stone was a chance she got once. That time she actually had a narrow escape. She was seriously injured and it took her three months to recover.
At first, they didn't know what it was. It was only later that their father met an expert and received advice, and then they realized that it was a vitality stone. It was at that time that they also knew what the vitality stone did.
As long as there is occult magic, the vitality stone is equivalent to the effect of high-grade ginseng, which can kill people.
When someone is seriously injured, a piece of fine old ginseng can be said to be life-threatening if held in the mouth. The same goes for the Life Stone, which can draw out the life inside and put it into the body, and it can lead to death.
If there is enough vitality, it is almost equal to an extra life. But the expert said that it is generally impossible to have so many vitality stones, and it is a great opportunity to get one.
Because there was only one piece, her father did not ask her to hand over the vitality stone, but asked her to keep it by herself.
However, I have also warned those who know about it in the clan not to reveal this matter casually, so as not to attract unnecessary covetousness.
Most people may not know how to use the vitality stone at all, but if they meet people from Xuanmen who know how to use it and how precious it is, they will definitely become greedy.
Situ Jiaxuan did not expect that this young man whom she regarded as a biological brother would tell the matter directly.
You know, some of the people here are from Xuanmen!
By saying this, are you not afraid of causing trouble for her?
Or, because these people saved them, they must be good people?
Situ Jiaxuan's face was expressionless.
Yin Changxing and Yin Yunting were a little surprised. Unexpectedly, she had a vitality stone in her hand.
Although Situ Geng felt that it was not good to speak out directly about this matter, there was a reason for the matter now. Wouldn't this be used by his brother?
So he also looked at Situ Jiaxuan, "Jiaxuan, why don't you take out the vitality stone and give it to Xiao Shun first? You don't want to see anything happen to him, right? It just so happens that these masters know mystical arts and should know how to use the vitality stone."
In fact, it was useless for Situ Jiaxuan to hold the vitality stone because they didn't know how to use it.
So Situ Geng thought it would be most appropriate to use it to treat Xiao Shun while there are people here who can use it.
Situ Jiaxuan said, "I didn't bring the vitality stone with me, it's at home."
She has always been regarded as a genius by her tribe, and also as the honor of the family. The greater the honor, the greater the responsibility, so she often comes out to do things for the tribe, and her parents often give her tasks to complete before she can return.
Those tasks are often not easy to say, and she often encounters danger!
Even if she doesn't know how to use the vitality stone, in fact she has been looking for someone who can teach her how to use it!
Once she finds it and learns to use it, it will be her life-saving trump card from now on.
Now they asked her to give up the vitality stone with just a few words.
Situ Jiaxuan looked at Yin Changxing and asked, "Master, can he slowly think of a solution in this situation?"
title_en: Chapter 2385 There is a vitality stone Chapter 2384 We still have to rely on her
